page_title: UNI 2-0 KOL | Union Berlin v FC Koln 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+3' FC Koln are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
90+1' A pass from Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) is intercepted by Frederik Ronnow and the move breaks down.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
87' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
85' It will be a substitution. Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) is ready to enter the pitch as Andras Schafer walks off.
84' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
84' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
82' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) is adjudged offside.
81' A corner kick by FC Koln is thwarted by the well prepared Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin).
80' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Max Finkgrafe and he is replaced by Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln).

79' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for FC Koln.

78' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Kevin Volland, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin), who beats Marvin Schwabe with a brilliant shot into the top right corner. 2:0.
76' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom left corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
74' It's time for a substitution. Florian Dietz (1. FC Koln) comes on in place of Davie Selke.
74' Here is a change. Mark Uth is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln).
74' Eric Martel goes off the pitch and Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) comes on.

72' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Marvin Schwabe inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but was denied by a great save.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Janik Haberer departs the field of play to be replaced by Leonardo Bonucci (Union Berlin).
62' Nenad Bjelica has decided to make a change. Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) replaces Jerome Roussillon.
62' Nenad Bjelica has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alex Kral (Union Berlin) replacing Benedict Hollerbach.
60' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jan Thielmann.
59' Deniz Aytekin couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) and blew his whistle.

56' 1 - 0 Goal! Kevin Volland shows great vision to find Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the top left corner. 1:0.
53' FC Koln failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
52' The resulting corner from Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
51' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) stoops for a header low near the left post from a cross, but the goalkeeper pulls off a great save!
50' The ball is cleared after Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Nenad Bjelica gives a chance to David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) and Kevin Behrens is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar!
45+1' Union Berlin take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+1' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing.
43' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!
42' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
42' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) gets inside the box and tries to beat Frederik Ronnow with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
36' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
35' FC Koln are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
32' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
31' None of the FC Koln players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
28' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
25' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
20' A player from FC Koln commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
19' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
18' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Deniz Aytekin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
14' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) commits a rough foul. Deniz Aytekin stops the game and makes a call.
12' FC Koln can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Rough tackle by Diogo Leite (Union Berlin). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
8' A player from Union Berlin commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
7' It will be a corner kick for Union Berlin.
6' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul.
4' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
1' A pass from Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) is intercepted by Frederik Ronnow and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and FC Koln will have the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin will officiate today.
